analysis.rationale: R1 signal re-analysis reproduces R0 exactly. No deterministic family/severity reaches high PSNR, and blur_glass is an njit pixel-shuffle whose RNG state is fixed (pair0 replicate 24.62 -> 24.64), so the ~24.7 dB ceiling is an information-loss floor, not a parameter error. Only remaining threshold-boundary signal is mild contrast weaken (spread_ratio 0.8161 vs 0.80). The contrast1 variant improved 5-pair support mean by +0.96 dB (4/5 pairs) but is below the +2 dB CHANGE bar and did not improve CI; a post-JPEG order variant scored 25.83 dB on pair0 but CI dropped to 5/10. Therefore NO_CHANGE, UNCERTAIN retained.
